decisions.reason: After several years without renewed visibility and with overlap inside the sensing portfolio, we infer results likely stayed below aspiration, so development attention should be redeployed.
As a next-generation replacement in a core voltage-measurement line, it likely remains above aspiration relative to its predecessor and is worth retaining.
The MQTT proxy strengthens platform interoperability at very low carrying cost, so organisational slack supports keeping it despite limited visible evidence of demand.
A CAN bus interface is strategically important for German industrial and embedded customers, so absent clear signs of failure we would continue to carry it.
The CO2 sensor module fits the core sensing portfolio and likely compares reasonably with aspiration for similar platform modules, so we keep it while monitoring demand.
The touch panel accessory is peripheral to the firm's main modular sensing and interface business, and its lack of continued visibility suggests results below aspiration.
